reason: After thorough review of the 10-K filing excerpt provided for Academy Sports and Outdoors (ASO), no Total Addressable Market (TAM) was disclosed by the company. The filing contains extensive business descriptions, merchandising details, store operations, and competitive positioning, but does not include any company-published TAM figures, market size estimates, or addressable market disclosures in any segment. The company discusses its market positioning, geographic presence across 21 states with 322 stores, and various merchandise categories (Outdoors, Sports & Recreation, Apparel, Footwear), but provides no quantified TAM data from company sources such as investor presentations, capital markets days, or regulatory filings.
